model_source_note: In the 999 edition the pin that names where a model id came from is the user's own pin (recorded as user-pin); the onboarding edition records the same fact as department-pin. The gate accepts user-pin on claude-nine runs under the Item 28 step 3 alias.
precedence_note: Model resolution in 999 runs through the native kie skill's lookup (Row 3 MAP); this file carries the law the lookup is judged by, not model data.
